subject: Data Engineering
title: YARN: Hadoop's Resource Manager
description: Learn YARN: Hadoop's Resource Manager in one minute.

hook.text: Early Hadoop could only run MapReduce. YARN opened the cluster to any processing framework.

buildup.text: YARN separates resource management from job scheduling, letting multiple engines share the cluster.

discovery.text: With YARN, Spark, Tez, and Flink could all run on the same Hadoop cluster alongside MapReduce.

twist.text: YARN made Hadoop a platform, not just a processing engine — extending its life by years.

climax.text: By decoupling compute from the framework, YARN paved the way for the diverse ecosystem we have today.

punchline.text: YARN turned one engine into a platform for many.

quiz.question: What did YARN enable on Hadoop clusters?
options: Running multiple processing frameworks on the same cluster
